description: Defines the TlsHandshaker class, a base class for managing TLS handshake processes within QUIC, including cryptographic operations, certificate verification, and connection management.

classes.name: TlsHandshaker
classes.description: A base class managing TLS handshake operations for QUIC, including message processing, cryptographic secret management, certificate verification, and connection control.

classes.name: ProofVerifierCallbackImpl
classes.description: Inner class handling asynchronous certificate verification callbacks within TlsHandshaker.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Processes input data for TLS handshake at a specified encryption level.

methods.name: InputBytesRemaining
methods.description: Returns the number of input bytes remaining to be processed.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns the current parser error code.

methods.name: error_detail
methods.description: Provides details about the parser error.

methods.name: CryptoMessageParser
methods.description: Returns the crypto message parser interface.

methods.name: BufferSizeLimitForLevel
methods.description: Returns buffer size limit for a given encryption level.

methods.name: EarlyDataReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for early data acceptance.

methods.name: AdvanceKeysAndCreateCurrentOneRttDecrypter
methods.description: Advances cryptographic keys and creates a current 1-RTT decrypter.

methods.name: CreateCurrentOneRttEncrypter
methods.description: Creates a current 1-RTT encrypter.

methods.name: GetHandshakeState
methods.description: Returns the current handshake state.

methods.name: ExportKeyingMaterialForLabel
methods.description: Exports keying material for a specified label and context.

methods.name: AdvanceHandshake
methods.description: Called when a new handshake message is available for processing.

methods.name: CloseConnection
methods.description: Closes the connection with a specified error and reason.

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles connection closure events.

methods.name: is_connection_closed
methods.description: Checks if the connection is closed.

methods.name: FinishHandshake
methods.description: Finalizes the handshake process.

methods.name: OnEnterEarlyData
methods.description: Handles transition into early data state.

methods.name: ProcessPostHandshakeMessage
methods.description: Processes handshake messages received after handshake completion.

methods.name: ShouldCloseConnectionOnUnexpectedError
methods.description: Determines if connection should close on an unexpected SSL error.

methods.name: set_expected_ssl_error
methods.description: Sets the expected SSL error code.

methods.name: expected_ssl_error
methods.description: Gets the expected SSL error code.

methods.name: VerifyCertChain
methods.description: Verifies the certificate chain asynchronously.

methods.name: OnProofVerifyDetailsAvailable
methods.description: Handles completion of certificate verification.

methods.name: Prf
methods.description: Retrieves the PRF for the negotiated cipher.

methods.name: tls_connection
methods.description: Returns the associated TLS connection.

methods.name: ssl
methods.description: Returns the SSL object.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns the associated QuicCryptoStream.

methods.name: handshaker_delegate
methods.description: Returns the delegate interface.

methods.name: VerifyCert
methods.description: Verifies a certificate.

methods.name: SetWriteSecret
methods.description: Sets the encryption secret for writing messages.

methods.name: SetReadSecret
methods.description: Sets the decryption secret for reading messages.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Writes a TLS message to the QUIC crypto stream.

methods.name: FlushFlight
methods.description: Flushes the current flight of messages.

methods.name: SendAlert
methods.description: Sends a TLS alert and closes connection if needed.

methods.name: InfoCallback
methods.description: SSL info callback for logging or tracing.
